name: @decent/hub
description: Deployable ppppp-hub for Decent — public rendezvous/relay so nodes behind NAT can find each other
comment: Hub source is VENDORED in ./vendor (the npm ppppp-hub tarball omits HOMEPAGE.md + lib/public + lib/views via its files allow-list, so it can't run as published). ppppp-caps and ppppp-keypair are pinned to match the client (packages/backend) or the secret handshake fails.
